text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU autoscaler failed to provision additional nodes for pool 'inference-gpu-pool' (maxNodes reached) — queue length > 12k, 95th latency degraded. Triggered at 2143654321.

ops-oncall: seeing it, joining. queue size is crazy, autoscaler logs show 'Reached max node count' and K8s HPA not scaling.

diego: oncall takeover in 2m. can someone paste the cluster-autoscaler log lines?

maya: pasting snippets:```
I0821 14:58:12.345678 1 scale_up.go:400] node group inference-gpu-pool: desired size 24, min 2, max 24
I0821 14:58:12.347000 1 scale_up.go:410] NodeGroup inference-gpu-pool is at max size, not scaling up
```

ops-oncall: thanks. cloud quota shows vCPU and GPU quotas are at limit for the region. AWS console says limit 24 g4dn. We requested quota increase last week but not approved yet.

ava: customer impact: several production customers reporting timeouts and degraded throughput. CS bot flagged 3 enterprise tenants seeing 5–15% request errors and large request queues.

customer-success-bot: CS notes: "Tenant: health-checks-app reported 503s around 14:56-15:02. We are opening support SRs and will notify customers if ETA for mitigation > 20m."

diego: tactical plan: 1) free up nodes by draining lower-priority batch jobs; 2) reduce model replicas for non-SLA models; 3) temporary manual increase of autoscaler maxNodes if cloud provider allows; 4) route some traffic to fallback smaller models.

kevin: I can start draining batch queue jobs now. running:```
kubectl label jobs batch-job-*-lowprio batch-priority=evictable
kubectl delete pod -l batch-priority=evictable --namespace=batch --grace-period=30
```

ops-oncall: diego, can you request manual cap raise with infra-automation? we need +8 GPUs ASAP.

diego: starting manual cap-raise request. pinging infra-automation.

infra-automation: Received request: increase maxNodes for nodegroup 'inference-gpu-pool' by 8. Creating change set. Ran dry-run: cloud provider API returned 'QuotaExceeded' for g4dn.gpu. Opening support ticket 987654321 with priority high. Estimated response 30-90m.

maya: while waiting, let's patch HPA/autoscaler to be less aggressive with CPU headroom to prioritize more pods per node? also reduce maxBatchSize on inference workers to lower memory spikes.

diego: patch ready:```
kubectl patch hpa inference-hpa -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":24}}' --type=merge
```

ops-oncall: note: we already at 24. this won't help until node capacity increases. alternative: scale down non-critical model deployments:```
kubectl scale deployment rerank-model --replicas=1 --namespace=infra
kubectl scale deployment embedder-xl --replicas=0 --namespace=infra
```

ava: CS asked for ETA. told them we have mitigation steps in progress (evict low-priority jobs, route to fallback models) and that full capacity fix depends on cloud quota ticket.

customer-success-bot: updating customers: "We're mitigating impact by routing traffic and reducing background jobs; ETA for permanent restore ~30-90 minutes pending cloud quota escalation."

kevin: evicted ~70% of batch pods, freed ~6 GPUs worth of capacity. Queue dropped from ~12.1k to ~5.3k in 4m. Latency 95th improved from 2.1s to 1.1s for routed requests.

diego: good. I've also opened a manual node pool scale request with our infra console to add emergency nodes (if cloud permits hot-add). Request ID: NP-2024-0819-01.

ops-oncall: created temporary routing rule to send high-priority tenants to dedicated pool with reserved capacity. Config:```
route add --selector tenant in (tenant-a, tenant-b) --pool reserved-high-prio
```

infra-automation: support ticket 987654321 updated: cloud says they can provision +4 GPUs now via express quota, +4 more pending approval. ETA for +4: 12 minutes.

maya: prepping postmortem notes: timeline, why quota was hit (recent burst in training experiments + delayed quota approval), and suggested mitigation (auto-eviction policy, soft-limits per tenant, advance quota monitor alerts).

kevin: can we also temporarily reduce batch concurrency in workers? patching config:```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  MAX_CONCURRENCY: "8"
```

diego: infra-automation reports +4 GPUs added at 2143654478. cluster shows extra nodes, autoscaler now allowed to scale to 28. queue now 2.2k and falling.

ops-oncall: manual actions so far: evicted batch jobs, scaled down non-critical replicas, routing rule adds, manual node pool request, cloud express quota added +4. Still waiting on full +8.

customer-success-bot: CS updated tenants: mitigation reduced errors to <1% for critical tenants. Non-critical tenants still seeing degraded performance but routing and job eviction helped.

diego: passing to next oncall for monitoring and follow-up: @ops-oncall will remain in thread for 10m window. If queue grows >3k or errors >2% we escalate to incident commander.

ops-oncall: taking watch. leaving notes: need to follow up on quota approval, add automation to detect 'max node' conditions and preemptively throttle low-priority jobs.

IncidentBot: Incident resolved-ish: capacity partially restored at 2143654478. Marking as "mitigated". Please file incident postmortem and link SR 987654321 and NP-2024-0819-01.

diego: filing postmortem now, assigning owners for follow-ups: quota-alerting (maya), auto-evict policy (kevin), routing policy improvements (ava).

ava: noted. will coordinate customer comms for final resolution. :wave:

ops-oncall: closing handoff. monitoring for 30m then archiving thread. :white_check_mark:
